prompt: Glossy anime game key art built around a holographic game interface: crisp clean lineart, acid-green neon light with hot-magenta glitch accents, translucent glowing green interface windows with thin bright borders, stat bars, skill icons and hexagon grids floating in the air, faint scanlines and magenta-and-green chromatic-aberration glitch at the edges, green screen light reflecting on the face and hair. Waist-up in the lower part of the picture, three-quarter view at eye level, one hand on her hip resting on the hilt of her sheathed sword, the other raised and swiping a small floating interface panel; looking at the viewer with a sly smirk. The top quarter of the picture is dim green-black space with only faint interface glow and no window in it. Background: deep green-black space filled with translucent interface windows, stat bars, hexagon grids and skill icons; far behind her, a dim walled royal city of towers and rooftops at night, with parade banners strung between the towers. Colour palette: green-black, acid green, hot magenta and white; acid green dominates, not blue or cyan. Light: acid-green screen light from the interface windows in front, a hot-magenta glitch rim from behind. She is the only person in the picture, clearly a grown woman, dressed in opaque fabric. Every interface panel shows only bars, icons and grids: nothing written anywhere, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark.
